Transport Modes

سفينة شحن

A general term for a vessel, usually seagoing, designed to carry all types of non-passenger cargo, referenced in bills of lading and international shipping contracts.

What is سفينة شحن?

Definition

A general term for a vessel, usually seagoing, designed to carry all types of non-passenger cargo, referenced in bills of lading and international shipping contracts.

Operational example

The cargo freighter’s bill of lading lists all shipped items and is required for customs import clearance.

Localized term

سفينة شحن

Localized example

تسرد بوليصة الشحن لسفينة الشحن جميع العناصر المنقولة، مطلوبة للتخليص الجمركي.
